pairs.purpose: Compare the named Bitcoin topic with its saved BTC-expanded wording. Contexts identify the referent without adding post-specific limits.
Compare Lightning identified as the Bitcoin payment network with the explicit Bitcoin Lightning Network wording.
Compare the short and full country names with their own source contexts.
Compare Photographs and Photos without adding ownership or depicted-subject limits from context.
The numeric hashtag is present beside a freedom topic, but its own saved context does not identify what it names. Shared source-post membership supplies no relation.
Test a named operation whose own context omits the operation type against an explicitly military operation topic. Do not infer a mission from its codename or another entry.
America's own context supplies only a geographical reading. Test whether that establishes its extent without borrowing the other side's explicit United States disambiguation.

The football-themed advertisement and award context does not explicitly name a football code. Compare it with Soccer using only the supplied entries; inspect residual ambiguity rather than force a label.
The same trading activity has independent noncustodial and frictionless qualifiers. Shared context does not add the missing qualifier to either subject.
Two people hold the same stablecoin-growth view, but each subject explicitly attributes it to a different named person. Preserve both attributions.
The dated Gadwal photography and the Ricoh GR camera share a post. Keep the photography's explicit date/place and the camera topic's full scope without importing its one use from context.
Book recommendation and writing are associated activities. Test their whole scopes rather than equating recommendation with written recommendation or limiting writing to books.

Both diagnostic groups use differently worded entries identifying the Bitcoin payment network. Reverse each side's entry order separately and together. These are proposed groups, not accepted hierarchy nodes.
Different Bitcoin wordings and source posts propose one topic; retain every original context and compare against a separate singleton.
Three Bitcoin-mining entries describe different posts. Compare their proposed activity topic with Bitcoin without restricting mining to one block or the author's miners.
Propose a common photographs topic across varied contexts and wording; ownership and depicted objects remain context-only details.

Intentionally group Sunderland association football with explicitly American football. A related sport family does not establish one consistent topic. This constructed grouping is a diagnostic control.
Intentionally combine trading subjects with independent qualifiers. Test whether the broader singleton improperly erases their difference; no accepted group membership is claimed.
Intentionally mix Photographs with the Photography field. Related products and a field with activities are different scopes; the diagnostic group must not be silently broadened to agree.
Intentionally combine Bitcoin and Bitcoin mining. The broader and narrower topics are related but do not name the same full scope; this is an input conflict control, not an inferred hierarchy node.
